meta.title: Country Conditions
meta.source: SAMPLE DATA for layout testing (simulated, not real)

stability.name: GOV_WGI_PV.EST (official name)
stability.note: Political stability and absence of violence; about -2.5 to 2.5.

fdi.name: BX.KLT.DINV.WD.GD.ZS (official name)
fdi.note: Net inflows of foreign direct investment.

trade_open.name: NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS (official name)
trade_open.note: Exports plus imports of goods and services.

current_acct.name: BN.CAB.XOKA.GD.ZS (official name)
current_acct.note: Positive values are surpluses, negative values deficits.

pat_res.name: IP.PAT.RESD (official name)
pat_res.note: Patent applications filed by residents of the country, all patent offices reporting to WIPO.

pat_nres.name: IP.PAT.NRES (official name)
pat_nres.note: Patent applications filed in the country by nonresidents; a signal of foreign interest in protecting inventions there.

trademarks.name: IP.TMK.NRCT (official name)
trademarks.note: Trademark applications filed in the country by nonresidents, by count; a signal of foreign brands entering the market.

rnd.name: GB.XPD.RSDV.GD.ZS (official name)
rnd.note: Gross domestic spending on research and development.

hightech.name: TX.VAL.TECH.MF.ZS (official name)
hightech.note: Exports with high R&D intensity, such as aerospace, computers, pharmaceuticals and scientific instruments.

ip_paid.name: BM.GSR.ROYL.CD (official name)
ip_paid.note: Payments to other countries for the use of patents, trademarks, copyrights and similar rights, current US dollars.

ip_recv.name: BX.GSR.ROYL.CD (official name)
ip_recv.note: Receipts from other countries for the use of the country's intellectual property, current US dollars.

gdp.name: NY.GDP.MKTP.CD (official name)
gdp.note: Gross domestic product in current US dollars; a rough guide to market size.

gini.name: SI.POV.GINI (official name)
gini.note: 0 is perfect equality, 100 perfect inequality. Measured in survey years only.

remittances.name: BX.TRF.PWKR.DT.GD.ZS (official name)
remittances.note: Personal transfers and compensation of employees received.

under5.name: SH.DYN.MORT (official name)
under5.note: Deaths before age 5 per 1,000 live births.

co2.name: EN.GHG.CO2.PC.CE.AR5 (official name)
co2.note: Carbon dioxide emissions per person, excluding land use change.

renewables.name: EG.FEC.RNEW.ZS (official name)
renewables.note: Renewable share of total final energy consumption. Includes traditional biomass.

pm25.name: EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3 (official name)
pm25.note: Mean annual exposure to fine particulate matter.
